copy.curiosityHook: When Columbus finally sights land, the wonder of discovering a new continent quickly collides with the heavy, inescapable consequences awaiting the people who already live there.
copy.description: Ridley Scott’s sweeping historical drama follows Christopher Columbus on his ambitious voyage across the ocean to the New World, tracing the expedition’s profound and turbulent impact on the indigenous people he encounters.
copy.vibeSummary: Immersive, solemn, and grandly staged, offering measured pacing and deep dramatic weight best suited for focused solo viewing.
copy.whyWatch: Scott mounts a massive, visual voyage across uncharted waters, balancing the adrenaline of ocean exploration with the weighty, complicated human fallout of early imperial contact.

allowedMaterial: Christopher Columbus' voyage of discovery to the New World
Initial contact and effects on indigenous populations
Historical epic drama and adventure tone directed by Ridley Scott
excludedMaterial: Specific third-act historical resolutions and fates
